reason: RE-QUEUED 2026-08-23 after the auth path was pinned. The original run refused with refused_missing_prerequisite: hmdm booted clean but every login 401'd, and two rounds were spent believing the seeded admin password was unknown. It is 'admin' - the ENCODING was the problem. HMDM's /rest/public/jwt/login wants the MD5 HEX of the password, never plaintext (JWTAuthResource's own Swagger says so), and the stored value is SHA1(UPPER(hex(MD5(pw))) + '5YdSYHyg2U') with the salt a compiled-in constant in PasswordUtil. Verified end to end: SHA1(UPPER(md5('admin')) + salt) equals 349242D38ED8667B5C11D2412EBEA4636BD3CA3A, the hash observed in the container. run-live-lanes.sh now md5-hexes before POSTing, uppercase for the seeded/migrated row. This lane has authenticated on no machine to date; this run is the first that can.
notes: The hmdm image boots by downloading its war from h-mdm.com; on your Mac (no intercepting proxy) the in-container download should just work and the repair branch stays dormant.

If the panel JWT login shape differs from /rest/public/jwt/login on this build, the proof fails loudly at 'panel authenticates' — capture the response body in the log and lane-mail it; do not patch around it silently.

If it STILL 401s, capture the response body and lane-mail it rather than patching - the remaining unknown would be case handling on a UI-set password (UserResource stores the client md5 without uppercasing), not the algorithm.
